checks.reason: API reference says to attach the public API key to the X-API-Key header of each request; it is the only method offered.
systeme.io has a never-expiring Free plan (pricing FAQ) and its MCP page says the MCP/API-key feature is included in all plans including Free; API reference states no plan restriction.
Docs say the public API follows RESTful conventions.
systeme.io's own developer docs document the Systeme.io MCP server (MCP key via X-MCP-Key header); the snzeeee GitHub server is a separate community project.
Self-serve API key from account settings on a free account with documented REST endpoints means a toolkit can be built and tested today.
v3 API is authenticated with an API key sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <API key>'; no OAuth is documented.
New accounts since March 25, 2025 get a 60-day free trial (100 emails/day); after it ends API-key integrations stop sending unless a paid plan is chosen; the free plan was retired.
SendGrid Web API v3 is an HTTP/JSON REST API (SMTP relay is secondary).

Twilio's only hosted MCP (mcp.twilio.com/docs) is documentation search that indexes SendGrid docs but 'does not connect to a Twilio account or execute any API calls'; execute-capable tools are listed as future, and twilio-labs/mcp exposes Twilio's Public API, not SendGrid v3 — so API-capable SendGrid MCPs are community only.
API keys can be created during the self-serve trial, but sending stops after 60 days without a paid plan, which is a caveat on testing/launch.
Apps created in the Dev Dashboard (public and custom) obtain access tokens through OAuth, sent as X-Shopify-Access-Token.
Development stores and custom apps need no approval, but distributing to many merchants requires public distribution, which the page lists as 'Approval required: Yes' (App Store review).
REST Admin API is legacy since Oct 1, 2024 and new public apps must use the GraphQL Admin API from April 1, 2025, so GraphQL is primary as claimed.
Shopify documents its own Dev MCP server (@shopify/dev-mcp) and store-hosted UCP/Checkout/Customer Accounts MCP servers on shopify.dev.
Buildable and testable on free development stores, but multi-merchant launch requires public-distribution approval.
Over HTTPS the REST API uses HTTP Basic Auth with the consumer key as username and consumer secret as password (OAuth 1.0a one-legged only over plain HTTP).
Keys are self-generated at WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API (or via the /wc-auth/v1/authorize endpoint) on the free open-source plugin; no vendor gate.
WooCommerce exposes a REST API under /wp-json/wc/v3.
WooCommerce's developer docs document its MCP integration (developer preview): WooCommerce abilities served via the WordPress MCP Adapter and Automattic's @automattic/mcp-wordpress-remote proxy.
Buildable today, but each store is self-hosted so base URL and keys are per-tenant, and the MCP is a developer preview subject to breaking changes.
SCAPI/OCAPI calls use an Account Manager API client via OAuth (sign-in, client credentials or JWT); Shopper APIs use SLAS OAuth.
Sandboxes require the organization to purchase sandbox credits and a realm ID obtained from the account executive, plus Account Manager roles — no self-serve developer path.
Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI) and OCAPI are HTTP/JSON REST APIs authenticated with OAuth bearer tokens.
The B2C DX MCP server (@salesforce/b2c-dx-mcp) is published by Salesforce (SalesforceCommerceCloud org, Salesforce copyright) and can run Commerce API operations.
Gate is being an enterprise customer/partner with a realm, which the verdict enum lists under ready_with_caveats; borderline with blocked since no self-serve sandbox exists for a toolkit builder.
HTTP Basic authentication with API login and auto-generated API password is the only way to access the API.
Sandbox is 'completely free for any registered user' (dummy data, not billed); real data is pay-as-you-go — fits the free-sandbox definition.
DataForSEO v3 is an HTTP/JSON REST API.
DataForSEO's own page links github.com/dataforseo/mcp-server-typescript, npm dataforseo-mcp-server, Docker dataforseo/mcp, and a hosted endpoint mcp.dataforseo.com.
Self-serve credentials plus a free sandbox allow building and testing today.
All API endpoints require an API token passed in the x-api-token header.
Billing docs list a 'Scraper Free' plan with API tokens and say it includes 100 tokens per month with no credit card required.
API overview says it is built on REST principles with JSON bodies.
Docs call it 'the official Model Context Protocol server for MrScraper' (@mrscraper/mcp), hosted at mcp.mrscraper.com/mcp with OAuth 2.1 or API-key fallback.
Free plan with API tokens means a toolkit can be built and tested today with self-serve credentials.
Docs say to send your API key in the x-api-key header to https://api.waterfall.io.
API access is not self-serve: a team member reviews each key request (work email or booked call) and pricing is discussed on the call — a contact-sales gate.
HTTP JSON launcher/finder endpoints under api.waterfall.io with an OpenAPI spec.

Waterfall's agent docs offer only two agent skills (waterfall-direct-api, waterfall-integration) and the docs index has no MCP page; search found only unrelated 'waterfall enrichment' MCPs (Workato, LeadEnrich).
Usable documented API, but credentials require a sales-reviewed request, limiting testing until approved.
Since June 2026 developers can create self-managed OAuth clients (Authorization Code + PKCE) and make them public after domain verification; API tokens remain the alternative for direct API use.
OAuth is available on all plans including Free, and API tokens can be created on any free account.
Cloudflare API v4 is REST (a GraphQL Analytics API exists but is secondary).
Cloudflare hosts managed remote MCP servers, including the Cloudflare API MCP server at mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp covering 2,500+ endpoints with OAuth.
Free self-serve credentials, OAuth for third parties and a broad REST API allow building and testing today.
SQL API supports OAuth and key-pair JWT (plus programmatic access tokens); Snowflake's MCP docs recommend OAuth, with PAT only as fallback.
Trial runs 30 days or until the free usage balance is depleted, then the account is suspended until a credit card is added and it is upgraded; no permanent free plan.
Snowflake SQL API and Snowflake REST APIs are HTTP REST endpoints (drivers are the other access path).
Snowflake-managed MCP server (GA Nov 2025) is hosted by Snowflake and exposes Cortex Analyst/Search/Agents and SQL execution tools.
Buildable via self-serve 30-day trial, but continued testing needs a paid account and OAuth requires per-account security-integration setup.
